$schema.description: Points editors at this schema for autocomplete/validation.

extends.description: Other ruleman configs to inherit rules from. A path (./x, ../x) resolves relative to this file; anything else is an npm package name resolved from node_modules, whose rules check the consuming repo.

rules.description: The checks to run, in order.

state.description: 'present' fails if a listed path is missing or is not a regular file; 'absent' fails if anything exists there.

files.description: Files to check, relative to the config file. An entry containing *, ?, [ or { is a glob pattern matched against the working tree.

for_each.description: A glob matching directories. When set, every entry in `files` is checked inside each matching directory ('for all') instead of once at the top.

state.description: 'present' fails if a listed path is missing or is not a directory; 'absent' fails if anything exists there.

empty.description: If set, additionally requires zero (true) or at least one (false) entries. Only checked when state is 'present'.

directories.description: Directories to check, relative to the config file. An entry containing *, ?, [ or { is a glob pattern matched against the working tree.

for_each.description: A glob matching directories. When set, every entry in `directories` is checked inside each matching directory.

format.description: Parser to use for the file. yaml/toml are planned.

state.description: 'match' requires the comparison to hold; 'mismatch' requires it to fail.

comparison.description: How the value at `key` is compared with `expected`: deep equality, substring/element containment, or a regular expression `expected` must match.

key.description: Dot-separated path into the parsed document.

algorithm.description: Hash algorithm used to digest the file.

state.description: 'match' requires the file's digest to equal `expected`; 'mismatch' requires it not to.

file.description: Path to the file to hash.

expected.description: Bare hex digest of the algorithm's width (64 chars for sha256, no 'sha256:' prefix), compared case-insensitively. Record it with 'ruleman add --checksum <file>'.
